title: Space bound for the amplified machine
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine, and suppose that on every input and every choice string its total space use is at most $s(n)$, where $n$ is the input length. For every natural number $r$ and every decision function on the run count, the amplified machine formed using $r$ has total space use at most $3(r+1)k_Ns(n)$ on inputs of length $n$, where $k_N$ is the number of work tapes of $N$.
hypotheses_covered: $N$ uses at most $s(n)$ space for every input and choice string
A decision function on run counts is given
